name: Aura Shell Daemon
description: Headless service hosting the `shell` MCP — an agent's remote control for the AuraOS shell UI: overview, apps, workspaces, layouts, windows, zoom, viewport profiles, light/dark mode, fullscreen, lock screen, launcher, process manager.

provides.name: shell
provides.description: MCP that drives the AuraOS shell UI: one-call overview, apps by name, workspaces (list/switch/rename/new), layouts, windows (focus/rename/close/reload), zoom, viewport profiles (info/switch by name), light/dark mode, fullscreen, lock screen, launcher search, process manager, stop/kill with a confirmation challenge.
